decisions.reason: The 5V LED supply and level-shifter decision does not change the existing GPIO3-controlled standby cutoff behavior.
The source changes the separately represented LED supply and data logic, not the indicator board's role, LED count, or LED family.
The source concerns addressable LEDs and does not alter the sensor-board modules, connectors, or 3.3V I2C sensor supply.
Using the power board's 5V rail for LEDs does not change the standalone USB 3.3V regulator, activation condition, or powered load.
This Requirement already records a 5V GPIO3-switched rail powering the SK6812 LEDs; the source adds LED-side level shifting but does not change the rail state.
The interboard interface already carries 5V and 5V_EN, and the source does not change connector types, pinouts, or pin ordering.
The LED supply decision does not modify the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID/VSYS, or 3.3V power-path requirements.
Although the design may require level-shifter parts, the source does not independently change the BOM deliverable requirements or any recorded BOM-specific attribute.
The source has no effect on battery-connector placement, orientation, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
The source selects an electrical LED interface but makes no decision about component availability, cost, or sourcing strategy.
The 5V LED supply and level-shifter decision does not alter the power board's dimensions, mounting, USB position, or enclosure fit.
The source does not resolve or modify the battery connector's series, pinout, mounting type, or existing ambiguity.
